name: 進捗グラフと健全性の管理カード
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. LH09-0058 Japanese progress/health management card, complete component.
ORIGINAL full image1/crop image2/enlargement image5 PRIMARY for exact content, icon anatomy, stroke/optical weight, plot slopes, proportions, controls and details. Mock image3 SECONDARY Japanese wording. Historical candidate image4 is imperfect: its same green series, dashed empty icon and diagonal-arrow substitute are wrong, do not inherit those defects or heavy typography.
One compact white rounded card, logical367x431, fine neutral border/soft restrained shadow on PURE WHITE outer canvas. Small header「進捗」with tiny downward filled triangle, Meiryo Regular14/24, not bold or oversized.
Exact original two-series rising area plot: shared bottom-left origin, same right-end x; upper MAGENTA scope line to original high point, lower forest-green #1F6444 progress line to66.5% of upper rise. Both perfectly straight and THIN, translucent magenta/green fills fade to pure white at baseline. No y-axis/numbers/grid/extra metrics. Bottom labels「3月30日」「4月6日」Meiryo Regular12/16 gray.
Below four small equal pill tabs in source order「健全性」「状態」「チーム」「責任者」. 健全性 selected, restrained forest-green gradient with white label; other THREE white outlined pills, slate/gray regular labels. Keep equal compact dimensions, not one giant pill or unboxed text.
Below TWO health rows, labels Regular14/24, right-aligned counts: first ORIGINAL dashed thin circular badge with AMBER rising zigzag inside, label「更新なし」, count「1」. Second ORIGINAL small pale-green circular state badge with forest-green rising zigzag, label「順調」, count「1」. Match zigzag shape/optical stroke from enlarged original. Do not substitute empty circle, checkmark, diagonal arrow or generic icon. Preserve functional amber missing-update versus green on-track meanings. Status circle fill is small semantic indicator, not member chip.
No extra rows, legend, labels, title, values, button or nested card. Typography established Meiryo, zero tracking; white surfaces, coherent slate utilities, clear selected state, purposeful accents only.
reviewNotes: Historical v1 reviewed/preserved; restored magenta/progress distinction, original amber dashed/green health zigzags, four pills and counts1. Labels/header too heavy and title uses V rather than source filled triangle; targeted typography correction pending.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
